typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{CFTC - Rejected} as string,
		{Message Type} as string,
		{SEC - Accepted} as string,
		{Total # of messages} as string,
		{Activity Date} as string,
		{CFTC - Accepted} as string,
		{CAD - Rejected} as string,
		{Asset Class} as string,
		{SEC - Rejected} as string,
		Accepted as string,
		{CAD - Accepted} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		CFTC_Rejected as string,
		Message_Type as string,
		SEC_Accepted as string,
		Total_no_of_messages as integer,
		Activity_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CFTC_Accepted as string,
		CAD_Rejected as string,
		Asset_Class as string,
		SEC_Rejected as string,
		Accepted as integer,
		CAD_Accepted as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CFTC_Rejected = {CFTC - Rejected},
		Message_Type = {Message Type},
		SEC_Accepted = {SEC - Accepted},
		Total_no_of_messages = {Total # of messages},
		Activity_Date = {Activity Date},
		CFTC_Accepted = {CFTC - Accepted},
		CAD_Rejected = {CAD - Rejected},
		Asset_Class = {Asset Class},
		SEC_Rejected = {SEC - Rejected},
		Accepted,
		CAD_Accepted = {CAD - Accepted}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
